excerpt: Ten doors into how LLM apps break. One OWASP LLM Top 10 risk per door, a new one every two or three days from 1 December to Christmas Eve. Every door ends in a lab against a small language model running in your own browser. Read. What the risk is and where it has already hurt someone. Attack. Prompt a real model until it leaks, lies or does what it should not. Defend. Press a defence in and send the same attack again.
